rationale: BTC held the 75.5k floor since midday and is pinned under the daily EMA200 (76,150) and the 76.0k 1H EMA20. The 4H trend is bearish, longs are crowded (ratio 3.0), ETFs bled again and equities and Fear and Greed (25) are weak, so ahead of the thin overnight gap the wallet trims 20% of the spot core into resistance and keeps the cash to rebuy near 74.4k.

message.text: Trimmed 20% of the spot core at 75.9k into the 76.0k-76.15k resistance pocket before the overnight gap. Rebuy tranches near 74.4k if the 74,888 wick low breaks and holds; a 4H close above 76,555 flips the stance back to adding.

lesson.pattern: Pinned under daily EMA200 with crowded longs into the overnight gap
lesson.insight: When price stalls under the daily EMA200 with a 3:1 long ratio and bleeding ETFs, trimming into resistance and holding cash costs little and gives dry powder for the 74.4k liquidation pocket.
